[[File:Justiciar Zachariah chathead.png|left]]
'''Justiciar Zachariah''' is a [[Saradomin]]ist [[justiciar]] who roams the [[Wilderness]], hunting the demon [[Porazdir]]. 

During the [[Mage Arena II]] [[miniquest]], he has to be defeated in order to obtain [[Justiciar's hand|his hand]] for [[Kolodion]]'s spell. In order to summon him, players have to use an [[enchanted symbol]] to locate him, similar to using an [[enchanted key]] or [[strange device]].

==Mechanics==
[[File:Fighting Justiciar Zachariah.png|thumb|270px|left|A player fighting Zachariah.]]
Zachariah can only be harmed by the [[Saradomin Strike]] spell. As such, a [[Saradomin staff]] or [[staff of light]] is required to defeat him.

When fighting Zachariah, he occasionally swings his sword, releasing a shock wave aimed at the player's location. If they do not dodge, the attack will drag the player forward into [[melee]] range and bind them in place, where his sword is able to attack every {{Ticks|3}}.

His melee attacks hit much harder than his regular [[magic]] attacks, so moving out of the way of the shock wave attack is recommended to prevent this from happening. Alternatively, players can stand in a [[safespot]] so as to avoid all damage.{{Explain}} Zachariah's attacks hit through prayer for reduced damage.{{Explain|By how much?}}

He can also cast a [[tele block]] lasting one minute and freezes preventing the player from moving. 

==History==
[[File:Justiciar of the Owl.png|left|150px]]
Known as the Justiciar of the Owl, Zachariah was known as the wisest servant of Saradomin.{{CiteNPC|npc=Knight of the Owl|quote=[Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?] Saradomin's wisest of servants. It surprises me that you've not heard of his many feats.}} He had a personal love for lilies, and grew them alongside various foliage within the [[Hallowed Sepulchre]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Knight of the Owl|quote=These plants were grown personally by Zachariah, the Justiciar of the Owl. Anything he plants blossoms with unimaginable vigour. You may have noticed that he has a love for lilies.}}

During the [[God Wars]], after having secured the [[Stone of Jas]] against [[Zamorak]], Saradomin hid the Stone on the ocean floor south of [[Hallowvale]] and tasked Zachariah and [[Aliya]], the Justiciar of the Lion, to protect it.{{CiteNPC|npc=Zachariah|quote=...he has given us the task of protecting it [the Stone].}} Knowing [[Zamorak]] had given [[Porazdir]], his collector, the task of finding the Stone, he is duty-bound to hunt him down along with any others who wish to take it.{{CiteNPC|npc=Zachariah|quote=Zamorak has tasked his collector with finding the Eye. I will hunt him down before he does, along with any others who would try to claim it.}}

Today, Zachariah continues to hunt and do battle with Porazdir. As one of the first justiciars, he must be several thousand years old, presumably prolonging his life with magic. At some point, he lost his right hand and replaced it with a [[Justiciar's hand|magical one]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Knight of the Owl|quote=Strange, when I saw him last he had no magical hand to speak of...}}
